name: bu_Si4O8
title: SiO2 (Si4O8) crystal
description: Crystal structure prediction of SiO2 with 4 formula units (12 atoms) per cell, which fits alpha-cristobalite, tridymite and stishovite but not the experimental ground state alpha-quartz (Z=3; 29.6 meV/atom above the GM with NEP89). NEP89 over-stabilises open corner-sharing SiO4 frameworks (alpha-cristobalite 24.5 meV/atom below quartz): the putative NEP89 global minimum is an all-silica ABW zeolite framework (coordination sequence 4,10,21,36,54,...; 17.3 A^3/atom, 23% less dense than quartz), 5.1 meV/atom below alpha-cristobalite. NEP89 also has an unphysical hole with over-short Si=O bonds (1.30 A) and Si-Si bonds that lies 0.12 eV below this minimum; a Si-O guard floor of 1.45 A removes it (physical Si-O bonds are >= 1.5 A).
